name: Marni von Wilpert
summary:
Marni Lynn von Wilpert (born December 27, 1982) is an American attorney and politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for California's 48th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, she has served as a member of the San Diego City Council since 2020, representing District 5.  
Prior to serving in public office, von Wilpert worked as an attorney for the National Labor Relations Board, on the staff of the House Education and Labor Committee, and as San Diego Deputy City Attorney.
